name: Averley Water

ring.prompt: Welcome to Averley Water. Calls may be recorded and monitored. Please choose from the following options.

menu.prompt: To report a leak or a supply problem, press one. For a bereavement or a change of occupier, press two. For payments and metering, press three.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: Sorry, that option wasn't recognised. Please try again.

holdAnnouncement: You are moving up the queue. Thank you for holding.

clerk.greeting: Occupier services, Janet here. I'm so sorry for your loss. May I take the name of the account holder, and the date they passed away?

turns.reprompt: Sorry, my screen's being slow today — the full name and the date once more, please?

documents: nothing further if the property is being cleared; a copy of the death certificate only if the account was in credit
outcome.closing: That's the account closed as of the date you've given me, and a final statement is on its way. Your reference is {REF}. All the best to you and the family.

quirk: Shortest call of the set — one question, one reference, done.
